text_block_list.text:
Coming to the amusement park on a day 
off―――

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Jet, jet, roller coaster! Amusement parks 
are the absolute GREATEEEST!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whew~ El-chan, you're so energetic!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan! Listen up! You've gotta enjoy 
yourself to the absolute max!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aha! El's intuition is tingling. Spe-chan, 
you're feeling down right now, aren't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eh, eh?! El-chan, are you psychic...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Truth is... I'm not good at singing or 
dancing, so I just can't feel confident in 
the Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I was worrying about that, the 
President told me to think about the 
meaning of Winning Lives.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Meaning... Meaning... Just what could the 
meaning be~~~?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...You don't get what's truly important. 
El will grant Spe-chan a grand entrance 
into enlightenment!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's go! We're conquering every 
single scream machineee!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eh...?! Scream machines...?!

A few minutes later, Special Week's faint 
screams came drifting along the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaa~~~ I think I just saw the Three 
Goddesses,べ...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Spe-chan! Do you understand 
now?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Amusement parks are so much 
fun! I felt just like a potato packed in a 
shipping box!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Now then, on to our final ride! 
Here are your two choices!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The strongest, ultimate thrill, the 
world's longest roller coaster! Or... the 
spinning teacups!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A roller coaster versus teacups...? That's 
like ultra-spicy versus ultra-sweet!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then... You over there! I'll have you 
decide our destiny!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The final ride we shall conquer...! Will 
it be the world's longest roller coaster?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Or could it be the spinning teacups...? 
Which one should we pick, desu ka?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mommy...! Spe will—Spe will give it her 
absolute best, ganbarimasu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ack! Noooo! Eeeeeeeeeek—!!!

Special Week's screams echoed on and on, 
fittingly lasting the entire length of the 
world's longest coaster...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, they're so adorable, desu ne! Looks 
like we can finally relax and unwind at 
the end~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh, naive as sugar, deee-su. 
Spe-chan... life is a jalapeño pepper!!

Spun at terrifying speed by El Condor 
Pasa's superhuman strength, Special Week 
ended up completely dazed and woozy inside 
the cup.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~~. My head is spinning... But... that 
was... so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Amusement parks are just overflowing with 
thoughtfulness meant to bring joy to 
everyone, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It seems you have finally come to 
understand, de-su.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My pro-wrestler Papa once told me: "El, 
you must become like an amusement park!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We may be athletes, but there is always an 
audience watching us, deee-su.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Winning Lives are the exact same thing... 
Spe-chan, can you become an amusement park 
for them?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, El-chan...! I'm going to become 
a roller coaster!
